create_MANOHandModel: create a MANOHandModel instance from a directory containing MANO_LEFT.pkl and MANO_RIGHT.pkl model files
run_forward_kinematics: run forward kinematics on hand mesh using shape params, joint angles, global transform, and hand side
run_shape_only_forward_kinematics: run shape-only forward kinematics on hand mesh using only shape parameters with zero pose
load_MANOHandModel: load a MANOHandModel via the loadManoHandModel factory function given a model files directory path
review_MANO_FINGERTIP_VERT_INDICES: review the MANO_FINGERTIP_VERT_INDICES mapping of finger names to vertex indices on the hand mesh
